items.title: McCormick and Unilever deal one step closer: US approves, now it’s up to the UK
items.summary: McCormick has cleared a major hurdle in the United States regarding its planned acquisition of Unilever's food business. However, the transaction has not yet been finalized, as the British competition authority is still investigating the deal.

items.title: Grupo Fuertes acquires Nutrave in latest poultry deal
items.summary: Spain’s Grupo Fuertes has struck another protein acquisition with the purchase of local poultry processor Nutrave. The post Grupo Fuertes acquires Nutrave in latest poultry deal appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Snacks pricing, “urgency” on drinks – takeaways from PepsiCo’s Q3 results
items.summary: PepsiCo CEO Ramon Laguarta insisted the company would look “aggressively” at the costs associated with its drinks business in North America. The post Snacks pricing, “urgency” on drinks – takeaways from PepsiCo’s Q3 results appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Kruidvat (AS Watson) entrusts Belgium to Dutch COO
items.summary: Kruidvat will have a new female CEO in Belgium early next year. Katinka Ruikes will succeed Bert Verhoef as Managing Director on January 1 and will combine that role with her current responsibilities for the Dutch retail organization.

items.title: Estée Lauder invests €5.7m to cut water use at Belgium plant
items.summary: The Estée Lauder Companies is investing €5.7m in water circularity infrastructure at its Oevel manufacturing campus in Belgium, aiming to cut water consumption.

items.title: Tuscan Winemaker Antinori Sees Red After $6m Theft
items.summary: Thieves stole around 30,000 bottles of premium wine worth about €5 million from a Marchesi Antinori warehouse in Tuscany, Italy.

items.title: ESM’s Retail Wrap – ANGED, Coop Sweden, Carrefour, EU Economic Divide
items.summary: Spanish trade groups renew protected foods partnership; Coop Sweden announces price cuts; Carrefour introduces contract-free mobile service.

items.title: Carrefour sells 35 stores in France and Spain
items.summary: Carrefour has announced the sale of a real estate portfolio consisting of 35 stores in France and Spain to a real estate investor. This is a so-called sale-and-leaseback transaction, under which the retailer will continue to operate the stores.

items.title: Pilgrim’s Pride board to review takeover approach by Brazil’s JBS
items.summary: Pilgrim’s Pride board is reviewing whether to accept the latest takeover offer from Brazilian meat giant JBS. The post Pilgrim’s Pride board to review takeover approach by Brazil’s JBS appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Lidl GB Invests £400m In Price Cuts And Promotions
items.summary: Lidl GB has invested £400 million (€471.9 million) in promotions and price cuts so far this year to support British households.

items.title: Will Colruyt acquire 18 Belgian Carrefour supermarkets in exchange for Codifrance?
items.summary: Details regarding the possible sale of Codifrance, Colruyt’s French wholesale business, to Carrefour are not known, but according to a French newsletter, 18 Belgian Carrefour stores are also set to change hands. The retailer denies this.

items.title: Poland’s lower house passes curbs on alcohol sales, ban on advertising
items.summary: Poland’s lower house has backed a bill to extend a ban on alcohol advertising and introduce curbs on off-premise sales in the country.

items.title: Boots adds haircare brand OLAPLEX to growing portfolio
items.summary: OLAPLEX is to bring its bond-building technology to 36 Boots stores across the UK, and online at boots.com, with the roll out completed by November. Launching from 09 October, OLAPLEX’s science-led haircare will be more accessible to consumers “looking to take their hair health…

items.title: Edinburgh’s St James Quarter welcomes four major signings
items.summary: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield (URW) has secured four signings at Westfield St James Quarter in Edinburgh.

items.title: Mission Produce sets 2035 sales, earnings targets
items.summary: Mission Produce has set out a plan to double sales and triple adjusted EBITDA by 2035. The post Mission Produce sets 2035 sales, earnings targets appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Refresco Plots Potential IPO At $10bn-Plus Valuation, Sources Say
items.summary: Refresco and its owner KKR took pitches from investment banks in recent weeks for roles on a potential initial public offering, sources told Reuters.

items.title: Campari chairman ‘asked to face trial on tax evasion allegations’
items.summary: Campari chairman Luca Garavoglia has reportedly been asked by Italian prosecutors to stand trial over alleged tax evasion.

items.title: Cyclospora probe: Taylor Farms changes lettuce output at Mexico site
items.summary: Taylor Farms will suspend processing of iceberg lettuce from central Mexico for sale in the US or Canada during the cyclospora season. The post Cyclospora probe: Taylor Farms changes lettuce output at Mexico site appeared first on Just Food .

items.title: Molson Coors taps chief supply chain officer for Americas
items.summary: Matthew Hook will step into the role with a mandate of continuing to modernize operations and boost service levels.

items.title: US ‘craft’ distillery numbers fall as sales slide
items.summary: The number of active US ‘craft’ distillers has declined while sales also shrunk in value and volume terms for the third consecutive year.

items.title: Leftovers: BeatBox jams with Cinnabon | Topo Chico launches premium canned water
items.summary: The party punch brand is bringing an April Fools' joke to life, while Bauducco looks to introduce panettone to Americans with Skippy peanut butter.

items.title: Carrefour and Kruidvat offer cryptocurrencies on their shelves
items.summary: At Carrefour and Kruidvat, customers can now buy cryptocurrencies. These retailers are adding cryptocurrency gift cards to their lineup of gift cards. In doing so, they are introducing a high-risk investment product into the familiar retail environment, investment advisors warn.

items.title: adidas and ASOS unveil Paris pop-up
items.summary: ASOS and adidas Original’s have celebrated the launch of their latest collaboration, Collection 05, with an exclusive four day pop-up at the adidas Champs-Élysées store. The experience will run 16 to 19 October and follows the pair’s previous pop-up at adidas’ flagship store in…

items.title: Pilgrim's Pride Forms Special Committee To Review Meatpacker JBS Buyout Bid
items.summary: Pilgrim's Pride Corp said its board has formed a special committee of independent directors to evaluate JBS's unsolicited bid.

items.title: 7-Eleven's US Arm Looks To Move Supply Chain In-House As Inflation Bites
items.summary: 7-Eleven Inc is considering moving parts of its supply chain in-house in a bid to cut costs as stubborn inflation dampens US consumer demand.
